summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying its Q3 2026 Interim Management Statement, a routine quarterly earnings disclosure and not a special situation. Reported figures include attributable profit of £1.5 billion, a Q3 Return on Tangible Equity of 21.6% (20.2% year to date), capital generation pre-distributions of 71 basis points and EPS of 19.3 pence. Customer assets and liabilities reached £1,002.6 billion, up 1.6% in the quarter. The release references integration of Evelyn Partners and the 2026 first-time buyer lending target. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor are stated.
